India and New Zealand Elevate Ties with Strategic Partnership and Trade Deal

During Prime Minister Modi's visit to New Zealand, both nations announced a strategic partnership and a "Roadmap to 2030" aimed at enhancing cooperation in areas like defense, security, and business. The visit also saw the Free Trade Agreement (FTA) enter the ratification stage, with leaders highlighting its potential to boost bilateral trade and economic ties. While the agreement is being presented as a significant step forward, it has also faced some pushback.
